C0560.title: Supervisor Embezzles 297 Phones via COD Refusal Scheme
C0560.summary: An operations supervisor colluded with e-commerce platform insiders to purchase phones using coupons with cash-on-delivery. Upon receiving the phones, he marked orders as 'refused' to defer payment, sold the phones at retail stores for cash, then later changed order status to 'received' and paid the discounted amount, pocketing the coupon difference.
